hana_cs: Heads-up: Nebulon onboarding tomorrow 08:45PT. Need Dedicated pool primed: steady 220 RPS target, autoscale min 5 max 22. Requesting a concise runbook with quota mapping, priming steps, and rollback criteria. Can ops run the window?

kevin_ops: Yes, ops will run. Plan: quick smoke 4m at 40rps, ramp 25m to 220rps, 8m spike to 330rps, then 20m soak. Will capture traces + token costs. Need quota id + KMS role.

omar_sre: Reserving 2 nodes in us-west-2 for 08:30-10:30 PT. Autoscale temp target_util -> 52%. PR #4360 for patch. Rollback if sustained 5xx >1% for 2m or p99>2s for 3m.

lina_se: Payload note: heavy long-contexts present. Recommend prefix cache TTL 10m, kv entries 6k, enable small-key dedupe. I'll publish the priming config to test namespace.

devbot: billing mapping: quota 76422 -> nebula-priming-us -> NB-ENT-PRIME-2024 :white_check_mark:

hana_cs: Action items assigned and post-test sync at 10:40PT. I'll send the customer a one-page runbook and feedback form. Closing unless blockers.
